notes.title: Engine update
notes.content:
Apologies for the slow updates lately. We have been working on a major upgrade to the game engine so we can start delivering faster and more consistent updates.

- Major update to the latest game engine.
- Fixed issue with cats not displaying in menu.
- Fixed issue with players not being able to delete tiles.
- Fixed crashing issues.
- Other minor bug fixes and improvements.

If you notice any issues or bugs with this new engine, please let us know as soon as possible we can quickly investigate.

notes.title: New Update
notes.content:
+ Explore the beauty of your world in a whole new way. Access first-person mode by tapping on a character and pressing the "Control character" button on the bottom left corner.
+ Chop trees, farm crops, and mine gold in first-person.
+ Ride your horsie.
+ Added two distinct game modes: 
== Survival sandbox!
== Ultimate sandbox!
+ Added setting to change brightness / saturation. 
+ Improved area loading speed.

notes.title: Major content update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35415451/ef2ac9b840526d16431db636e5e9206ec733e077.png[/img]

+ Boo! Added 59 spooky items, all under the new "Spooky Specials" tab!
+ Over 80+ new pre-unlocked items!
+ 42 new unlockable bonus items!
+ Added the duplicate feature! Select an item in the world and press the duplicate button on the bottom right corner.
+ Added new performance settings! If your device can't handle your large world, try reducing the performance settings.
+ Added advanced settings! Change shadows, FPS, and anti-aliasing.
+ Performance improvements! Areas of your world will now load in chunks when in view, and unload when out of view. Slightly longer initial load time, but overall much better performance.
+ Improved controls! Another checkmark button has been added to the bottom right corner when building.
+ Improved UI! UI will be hidden when moving items, so you can have a better view of the world when building. Less clunky!
+ Bug fixes!

notes.title: Update 2.6.1
notes.content:
Hello Builders,

This little update mainly has some new key shortcuts and settings suggested by our players.

+ Added setting to adjust zoom sensitivity. 
+ press F to Toggle freeform mode (disable all snapping).
+ You can now click on a character and press "Enter" to instantly access first-person mode.
+ WASD can now be used to control the item. Use A/D (left, right) to rotate and W,S (up/down) to move the item vertically.
+ You can now run in first-person mode. Hold shift to run. 
+ Press CTRL + R to reset the camera back and go back to the start position.
+ Fixed some silly little bugs.

Stay tuned for more regular awesome updates!

notes.title: Shortcut keys to make building a little easier
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35415451/5a9a5a59a99bc244263bdb80089228656421b566.jpg[/img]

Hi Everyone,

I will be mentioning these inside the game in future updates but here are some shortcut keys to help building easier. If you have any ideas for more shortcuts, ket us know here https://steamcommunity.com/app/1077530/discussions/1/1638669204742815806/ we will be keeping that list updated with all shortcut keys that are added in the game.

B - Open/close build menu
R - Rotate item
Space - Build item
SHIFT + click - Rotate camera
CTRL + Z - Undo (PC)
CTRL + Y - Redo (PC)
CMD + Z - Undo (Mac)
CMD + SHIFT + Z - Redo (Mac)
Backspace - Delete selected item
CTRL + S - Save (PC)
CMD + S - Save (Mac)

Hi everyone, thank you for your patience. BUILD is now available to purchase. This game is early access so you might stumble into some issues, or expect a feature that's not yet available. If you have an idea for the game, or you've bumped into a bug, just let us know, and our lovely cubs at MOONBEAR will look into it right away.
